tools.name: orch_registry_ping
tools.purpose: Pilot A01 lane tool that echoes a short token so register, call, test, and document can be proven without writing the task store.

tools.name: orch_dag_order
tools.purpose: Order a task DAG the way orch_plan does, and reject a cycle instead of hanging.

tools.name: orch_budget_class
tools.purpose: Return the token, wall, and cost budget orch_plan assigns to a risk class.

tools.name: orch_plan
tools.purpose: Orchestrator unit: decompose brief into typed task DAG (plan).

tools.name: orch_run
tools.purpose: Orchestrator unit: assign tasks, monitor DAG execution (run).

tools.name: orch_reconcile
tools.purpose: Orchestrator unit: reassign on failure, aggregate gate results (reconcile).

tools.name: orch_assign
tools.purpose: Orchestrator unit: assign task to agent (part of monitor/assign).

tools.name: orch_dag_blocked
tools.purpose: Classify a plan's dispatchable tasks as ready, waiting, or blocked, and report dependency cycles, so A01 dispatches only tasks whose inputs are met.

tools.name: orch_gate_coverage
tools.purpose: Check the latest verdict per gate against the gates a risk class requires, so A01 approves a task only when every required gate passed or was waived.

tools.name: orch_rework_bound
tools.purpose: Apply the rework-loop cap to a gate failure and return REWORK, ESCALATED, or PASS with the loops left, so A01 escalates after the second rework.

tools.name: orch_dispatch_batch
tools.purpose: Choose which ready tasks start this round under each agent's max_parallel and the global cap, with the deferred ones and their reason.

tools.name: orch_budget_guard
tools.purpose: Decide OK, WARN, HARD_STOP, or ESCALATED from usage against a task budget and earlier breaches, and name the next action.

tools.name: req_gwt_check
tools.purpose: Count Given/When/Then acceptance criteria in a text block.

tools.name: req_invest_score
tools.purpose: Score one user story against the six INVEST checks using its text, dependencies, estimate and criteria.

tools.name: req_ambiguity_scan
tools.purpose: Flag modal, quantifier and vague terms in requirement text and score the share of sentences that are ambiguous.

tools.name: req_story_duplicates
tools.purpose: Find user stories whose normalized token overlap (Jaccard similarity) meets a duplicate threshold.

tools.name: req_wsjf_rank
tools.purpose: Rank backlog items by WSJF from supplied value, criticality, risk and job size, and name the prioritization method policy applies.

tools.name: req_criteria_testability
tools.purpose: Measure the manual-only share of acceptance criteria and list criteria that can be verified neither automatically nor by a measurable outcome.

tools.name: req_traceability_coverage
tools.purpose: Compute requirement-to-artifact traceability coverage from requirement and link id lists, reporting uncovered and unknown requirement ids.

tools.name: req_change_impact
tools.purpose: Estimate tasks at risk and committed-scope change ratio from the requirement ids a change affects and the requirement-to-task links.

tools.name: req_nfr_coverage
tools.purpose: Check that a set of NFRs covers the required categories (perf, security, a11y, i18n, compliance) and list the missing categories.

tools.name: req_pii_scan
tools.purpose: Detect email, phone, SSN, Luhn-valid card and IPv4 patterns in brief or story text and return a redacted copy with regime hints.

tools.name: req_clarification_window
tools.purpose: Account clarification rounds against the 2-round, 48 h rule from supplied timestamps and report overdue rounds, exhaustion, provisional need and P50 latency.

tools.name: req_conflict_matrix
tools.purpose: Detect contradictory structured requirements on the same subject and attribute and emit the conflict matrix, blocked ids and equal-rank pairs.

tools.name: arch_adr_slug
tools.purpose: Slugify an ADR title the way arch_adr.py does.

tools.name: arch_contract_ops
tools.purpose: Count OpenAPI or AsyncAPI operations in a contract document.

tools.name: arch_semver_bump
tools.purpose: Classify the bump between two release versions and check it against the bump a breaking or additive contract change requires.

tools.name: arch_field_breaks
tools.purpose: List the breaking and additive field changes between two field sets of one contract side, request or response.

tools.name: arch_layer_violations
tools.purpose: Find module dependency edges that point from a layer to a layer above it in the ordered layering.

tools.name: arch_cycle_check
tools.purpose: Find dependency cycles, as strongly connected module groups and self-edges, in a supplied module dependency graph.

tools.name: arch_c4_fanout
tools.purpose: Count C4 containers and distinct relations, and flag containers whose fan-out exceeds the coupling budget.

tools.name: arch_adr_transition
tools.purpose: Decide whether an ADR may move from one status to another under the lifecycle recorded by the ADR script.

tools.name: arch_nfr_budget
tools.purpose: Check measured NFR values against their allocated budgets and report breaches and budgets that have no measurement.

tools.name: arch_nfr_allocation
tools.purpose: Check that every NFR is bound to a contract clause or component budget and that each quantitative NFR carries a numeric limit; report unallocated and unmeasurable ones.

tools.name: arch_breaking_readiness
tools.purpose: Decide the autonomy level of a contract change and list the migration plan, consumer acknowledgements and human approval still outstanding before it may be published.

tools.name: arch_adr_supersession
tools.purpose: Validate the supersession links of an ADR set: dangling targets, superseded ADRs without a successor, status mismatches, forks and cycles, with chains and live heads.

tools.name: ux_contrast
tools.purpose: Compute the WCAG contrast ratio for a foreground and background hex pair; the ratio is truncated, never rounded up, to two decimals so it cannot cross the 3, 4.5 or 7 thresholds.

tools.name: ux_token_name_check
tools.purpose: Check design token names against the kebab-case dot-path convention, depth limit, allowed roots and duplicates.

tools.name: ux_target_size_check
tools.purpose: Check interactive targets against the WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 24 CSS px minimum, including the spacing exception.

tools.name: ux_scale_monotonic_check
tools.purpose: Check that a colour tone scale is strictly monotonic in WCAG relative luminance in the stated order.

tools.name: ux_spacing_scale_check
tools.purpose: Check spacing values are integer multiples of a base unit and report the multiplier of each on-scale value.

tools.name: ux_state_coverage_check
tools.purpose: Check that every required component state family is declared, treating dotted sub-states such as error.network as covering error.

tools.name: ux_focus_contrast_check
tools.purpose: Check focus indicator contrast against each adjacent surface meets the required non-text contrast ratio.

tools.name: ux_motion_duration_check
tools.purpose: Check animation durations stay within a bound and that each animation offers a reduced-motion variant.

tools.name: ux_breakpoint_order_check
tools.purpose: Check responsive breakpoints have unique names and strictly ascending minimum widths in the declared order.

tools.name: ux_token_semver_impact
tools.purpose: Diff two flat design-token maps and name the semver bump, next version, and removed tokens that still lack a deprecation alias; a breaking change is L3.

tools.name: ux_spec_completeness_check
tools.purpose: Check one ux.spec against the output_format shape: required fields, fidelity and version values, required states, focus order against interactive ids, AC refs and contrast floor.

tools.name: ux_ac_trace_check
tools.purpose: Trace acceptance-criterion ids to per-screen ux.spec acceptance_refs both ways by id; unlike shared_dod_check it matches no evidence text, it finds uncovered ACs, unknown refs and orphan screens.

tools.name: be_route_norm
tools.purpose: Normalize an HTTP path template the way be_contract_conformance.py does.

tools.name: be_openapi_path_params
tools.purpose: Extract OpenAPI {name} path parameters from a route template so contract checks compare declared and used parameters.

tools.name: be_route_collision
tools.purpose: Detect same-method routes whose templated shapes collide so the backend API surface has no ambiguous dispatch.

tools.name: be_method_status_check
tools.purpose: Check an endpoint's HTTP method and response status against the allowlists in its API contract.

tools.name: be_semver_range_class
tools.purpose: Classify a dependency semver range and report whether it has an upper bound so unbounded backend dependencies are flagged.

tools.name: be_license_allowlist_check
tools.purpose: Flag backend dependency packages whose license expression is not covered by the approved license allowlist.

tools.name: be_coverage_delta
tools.purpose: Compute the percentage-point test coverage change between two backend runs (full precision) and flag regressions; any drop below before is regressed with direction down.

tools.name: be_acceptance_coverage
tools.purpose: Compute the share of acceptance criteria covered by a backend test plan and list the criteria still uncovered.

tools.name: be_perf_regression
tools.purpose: Flag benchmarks whose after-timing is slower than a percentage budget against their baseline timing.

tools.name: be_dependency_class
tools.purpose: Classify each proposed dependency change as L2 (allowlisted, semver-compatible: same major, and for 0.x the same minor, not a downgrade) or L3 (new, major, downgrade or off-allowlist).

tools.name: be_route_auth_coverage
tools.purpose: List new routes that carry no auth marker and are not in the declared public list, matching paths by normalized shape.

tools.name: be_patch_shape_check
tools.purpose: Validate the code.patch JSON an implementer emits (branch, contract pins, digest, checks, tests, signing) and say whether it is ready for review.

tools.name: fe_a11y_scan
tools.purpose: Scan an HTML snippet with the fe_a11y_check rules and return the issue count.

tools.name: fe_heading_sequence_check
tools.purpose: Check that heading levels start at h1 and never skip a level when descending, as the a11y self-gate requires.

tools.name: fe_alt_text_check
tools.purpose: Flag non-decorative images with missing, empty, or generic alt text and decorative images that carry alt text.

tools.name: fe_form_label_check
tools.purpose: Find visible form controls that lack an accessible name from a label, a non-blank aria-label, or aria-labelledby.

tools.name: fe_tab_order_check
tools.purpose: Count positive tabindex values and the focus-order inversions they create among supplied DOM-ordered elements.

tools.name: fe_bundle_budget_check
tools.purpose: Compare total bundle bytes against a byte budget and, when a baseline is given, against the regression limit percentage.

tools.name: fe_prop_type_coverage
tools.purpose: Measure the share of component props with a concrete declared type and list components below the minimum ratio.

tools.name: fe_target_size_check
tools.purpose: List interactive targets smaller than the minimum CSS-pixel size on either side, default 24 px per WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8.

tools.name: fe_token_literal_scan
tools.purpose: Flag raw colour and spacing literals (hex, rgb/hsl functions, non-zero px/rem/em) in supplied style declarations that are not design-token references.

tools.name: fe_state_parity_check
tools.purpose: Compare the states implemented per screen or component with ux.spec states for exact parity, listing missing and extra states; dotted sub-states count separately.

tools.name: fe_cwv_budget_check
tools.purpose: Gate Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and Lighthouse scores against thresholds, defaulting to LCP 2.5 s, INP 200 ms, CLS 0.1, perf 90 and a11y 100.

tools.name: fe_client_security_scan
tools.purpose: Scan supplied source text for XSS sinks, inline scripts and handlers, external scripts or stylesheets without integrity, and PII or credential keys written to web storage.

tools.name: data_down_present
tools.purpose: Report whether migration text contains a down or reversible marker.

tools.name: data_destructive_ddl_scan
tools.purpose: Classify destructive DDL statements (DROP TABLE, SCHEMA, DATABASE, TRUNCATE, DROP COLUMN, column TYPE change) in migration SQL so L4 approval can be routed.

tools.name: data_not_null_default_check
tools.purpose: Flag ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN definitions that are NOT NULL or PRIMARY KEY without a DEFAULT, which fail or rewrite populated tables.

tools.name: data_index_name_check
tools.purpose: Check CREATE INDEX names against the prefix_table_suffix convention, lowercase rule and 63-character identifier limit.

tools.name: data_fk_cycle_check
tools.purpose: Detect a cycle in supplied table-to-table foreign-key edges so migration ordering and cascade deletes can be reviewed.

tools.name: data_pii_tag_coverage
tools.purpose: Compute the share of PII-flagged columns that carry an allowed classification tag and list the untagged PII columns.

tools.name: data_contract_field_compat
tools.purpose: Classify field-set changes between two data contract versions as breaking or additive for BACKWARD compatibility.

tools.name: data_row_count_reconcile
tools.purpose: Reconcile a before row count and an after row count against a declared delta and report the drift.

tools.name: data_migration_version_order
tools.purpose: Check migration version ids are unique and strictly increasing in the supplied order, using natural numeric comparison.

tools.name: data_reversible_pair_check
tools.purpose: Pair up/down and Flyway V/U migration files by name and report missing or orphan reverse scripts.

tools.name: data_lock_risk_scan
tools.purpose: Flag DDL that takes blocking locks on populated tables (index build without CONCURRENTLY, validating FOREIGN KEY or CHECK, SET NOT NULL, column-level UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY or REFERENCES in ADD COLUMN, also inside DO blocks) and check that a lock_timeout is in effect at each of them so requires_lock_timeout_s can be confirmed.

tools.name: data_explain_regression_check
tools.purpose: Compare baseline and shadow EXPLAIN cost or time per query against the percentage regression budget (default 20) before shadow_tested is set.

tools.name: qa_runner_detect
tools.purpose: List test runners qa_gate would detect at this repo root.

tools.name: qa_flaky_classify
tools.purpose: Classify each test's recent pass/fail history under the A08 flake policy: quarantine at 3 of the last 10 clean runs failing intermittently.

tools.name: qa_criteria_coverage
tools.purpose: Map A02 acceptance criteria to test traces and report uncovered criteria and tests that trace to no known criterion.

tools.name: qa_mutation_gate
tools.purpose: Compute the mutation score for a critical module and check it against the A08 mutation threshold, 70 percent by default.

tools.name: qa_runtime_p95
tools.purpose: Compute nearest-rank P95 suite runtime from supplied durations and check it against the 45-minute escalation budget.

tools.name: qa_skip_ratio
tools.purpose: Compute the skipped-test ratio and list skipped tests with no recorded reason against a caller-supplied limit.

tools.name: qa_defect_escape_rate
tools.purpose: Compute pre-production detection and production escape rates from defect stages against the A08 quality targets.

tools.name: qa_retry_budget
tools.purpose: Check flaky-rerun use against a rerun budget and list tests that passed only after a retry or never passed.

tools.name: qa_name_convention
tools.purpose: Check test names against the supplied prefix, snake_case, length limit, and uniqueness rules.

tools.name: qa_tier_plan
tools.purpose: Say which test tiers a risk class requires and whether the reported run statuses pass or fail the quality gate; degraded mode narrows the requirement to the unit smoke tier and is a planning input only, because scripts/qa_gate.py has no degraded mode and always selects tiers by risk class.

tools.name: qa_finding_shape_check
tools.purpose: Check quality-gate findings against the A08 finding contract before the gate call: QF-n ids unique, kind and severity in their enums, ac_ref on functional findings, evidence on major and critical ones.

tools.name: qa_defect_dedupe
tools.purpose: Group defect reports that share a dedupe key (derived from component, acceptance criterion and normalized title when absent) and name the canonical report and the duplicates.

tools.name: rev_diff_size
tools.purpose: Report whether an added plus deleted line count exceeds the review split budget.

tools.name: rev_sensitive_paths
tools.purpose: Classify changed paths into restricted categories (contracts, auth, payments, migrations, PII, IaC) and report whether co-sign is required.

tools.name: rev_auto_approve_check
tools.purpose: Apply the L2 auto-approve thresholds (diff under 100 lines, no restricted paths, SAST clean, tests present, first-pass rate above 90 percent) and name each failed criterion.

tools.name: rev_review_latency_p95
tools.purpose: Compute the nearest-rank P95 of supplied review durations in minutes and compare it with the review latency target.

tools.name: rev_severity_histogram
tools.purpose: Count finding severities on the gate scale (info, minor, major, critical, blocker), the blocking count at major and above, and the highest severity present.

tools.name: rev_false_approve_rate
tools.purpose: Compute the percentage of approved reviews later linked to defects and compare it with the false-approve target.

tools.name: rev_comment_density
tools.purpose: Measure the share of non-blank added source lines that are comment lines, excluding preprocessor and shebang directives.

tools.name: rev_test_pairing
tools.purpose: Pair changed source files with test files by stem, report the test-to-source ratio and list source files with no matching test.

tools.name: rev_unresolved_threads
tools.purpose: Count review threads still open, including open blocking threads, and report whether no blocking thread remains unresolved.

tools.name: rev_risk_tier
tools.purpose: Derive risk_tier low, medium or high: high when co_sign_required or max_severity is critical or blocker; medium when any restricted category is present, diff_lines is at least 100 (the auto-approve size threshold) or blocking_count is above 0; else low.

tools.name: rev_verdict_shape
tools.purpose: Check the final review json block against the output contract (gate review, verdict pass or fail with approve, request_changes and block normalized, blocking and non_blocking item fields, risk_tier, mode, co_sign_required, expires_s up to 172800) and list every field error.

tools.name: rev_rule_dispute_flag
tools.purpose: Flag review rules that one producer disputed on at least threshold distinct pull requests (default 2) for standards review; counts are per rule and producer, and a repeated rule, pr and producer dispute counts once.

tools.name: sec_line_entropy
tools.purpose: Compute the Shannon entropy sec_gate uses before treating a string as a secret.

tools.name: sec_credential_scan
tools.purpose: Report hard-coded credential rule hits by rule name and line number, never the matched value.

tools.name: sec_cvss_band
tools.purpose: Map a CVSS base score to its qualitative severity band and the gate's high-or-critical blocking threshold.

tools.name: sec_dependency_age
tools.purpose: Measure a dependency release age in days against a supplied maximum for dependency-request review.

tools.name: sec_license_risk
tools.purpose: Flag license identifiers outside a supplied allowlist for the dependency license check.

tools.name: sec_tls_min_version
tools.purpose: Check TLS and SSL protocol versions against a minimum and report weak or unrecognized entries.

tools.name: sec_header_presence
tools.purpose: Report which required security response headers are absent from an observed header set.

tools.name: sec_kev_match_count
tools.purpose: Count distinct CVE identifiers that appear in a supplied KEV list for the KEV blocking rule.

tools.name: sec_sbom_summary
tools.purpose: Count SBOM components and those without an exact dotted-numeric pinned version.

tools.name: sec_finding_dedup
tools.purpose: Merge findings of several scanners by CWE and location, or by rule for flood batching; group severity is the maximum and differing severities are listed as conflicts.

tools.name: sec_allowlist_check
tools.purpose: Apply the sec_gate allow-list rules to supplied entries: report entries lacking a justification, entries expired on or before the as_of date, and which finding ids would be suppressed.

tools.name: sec_sbom_diff
tools.purpose: Compare two SBOM component lists by name: added, removed, version-changed and newly unpinned components, with a drift flag.

tools.name: devops_ci_kind
tools.purpose: Classify a path as a CI or IaC manifest the way devops_ci_check.py does.

tools.name: devops_build_systems
tools.purpose: List build-system markers devops_build_record finds at the repo root.

tools.name: devops_env_tier
tools.purpose: Classify an environment name as ephemeral, staging, or production and derive its autonomy level, as the A11 tier rules do.

tools.name: devops_change_gate
tools.purpose: Decide whether an environment change may proceed, requiring a change ticket, blast-radius note, and rollback plan for production.

tools.name: devops_drift_count
tools.purpose: Count GitOps drift between desired and actual state keys and choose the reconcile action under the three-reconcile freeze rule.

tools.name: devops_cost_overrun
tools.purpose: Compare an environment's actual cost with its modeled budget and flag overruns above 120 percent for auto-downscale.

tools.name: devops_image_tag_check
tools.purpose: Flag container image references that are not pinned by digest or an immutable version tag, rejecting latest and other mutable tags.

tools.name: devops_freeze_window
tools.purpose: Test whether a deploy timestamp falls inside any supplied freeze window, using UTC instants with start inclusive and end exclusive.

tools.name: devops_provenance_gate
tools.purpose: Self-gate a build.artifact record: reject without a provenance attestation, a sha256 tree digest or a digest-pinned image, and warn on a dirty tree.

tools.name: devops_deploy_gate
tools.purpose: Combine the A10 verdict, freeze window, drift freeze, provenance check and environment tier into allow, block or needs-human-approval, failing closed.

tools.name: devops_rollback_target
tools.purpose: After an IaC apply failure choose retry, rollback or escalate and name the newest last-good state snapshot, under the retry-once rule.

tools.name: devops_tf_blast_radius
tools.purpose: Summarise terraform show -json resource_changes into create, update, delete and replace counts and a note for devops_change_gate blast_radius.

tools.name: rel_canary_steps
tools.purpose: Build the canary step list and approval class rel_plan assigns to a risk.

tools.name: rel_canary_verdict
tools.purpose: Decide promote, hold, or rollback for one canary step from canary and baseline error rates, the regression allowance, and soak time.

tools.name: rel_rollback_trigger
tools.purpose: Report whether SLO burn-rate samples breach the rollback threshold for the required run of consecutive samples.

tools.name: rel_release_record_check
tools.purpose: Check that a release record carries every required field with a non-empty value before it is signed and appended.

tools.name: rel_change_failure_rate
tools.purpose: Compute the change failure rate from per-change failure outcomes over a release window.

tools.name: rel_deploy_frequency
tools.purpose: Compute deployments per week from supplied production deploy dates for the release record.

tools.name: rel_lead_time_p95
tools.purpose: Compute median and nearest-rank P95 change lead time in hours from supplied commit-to-deploy durations.

tools.name: rel_gate_order_check
tools.purpose: Verify that required promotion gates appear in the release plan in the required order with none missing.

tools.name: rel_gate_freshness
tools.purpose: Report which gate verdicts are older than their maximum age, waived without an approval id, or failed, at an injected now.

tools.name: rel_freeze_decision
tools.purpose: Decide whether incident alerts force a deploy freeze (severity 2 or worse) and whether an unfreeze request comes from the declaring authority.

tools.name: rel_resume_point
tools.purpose: Pick resume, rollback or complete for an interrupted canary promotion from the plan steps, the confirmed steps and the breach flag.

tools.name: rel_guardrail_breaches
tools.purpose: List the guardrails one canary sample breaches against the risk-class limits and the metrics it is missing.

tools.name: obs_error_burn
tools.purpose: Compute the SLI and error-budget burn rate obs_slo uses.

tools.name: obs_multiwindow_alert
tools.purpose: Decide burn-rate paging (14.4x over 1h with 6x over 6h) and ticketing (1x over 3d) for an SLO.

tools.name: obs_budget_remaining
tools.purpose: Compute remaining error budget for an SLO window from good and total event counts.

tools.name: obs_alert_fatigue
tools.purpose: Measure the non-actionable share of pages against the allowed alert-fatigue noise ratio.

tools.name: obs_incident_mttd_mttr
tools.purpose: Compute mean time to detect and mean time to restore from incident start, detection, and resolution timestamps.

tools.name: obs_ingestion_lag_p95
tools.purpose: Compute the nearest-rank P95 telemetry ingestion lag and check it against the ingestion target.

tools.name: obs_dashboard_staleness
tools.purpose: Check how old a dashboard's last refresh is at a supplied check time against the freshness limit.

tools.name: obs_runbook_link_coverage
tools.purpose: Report which alerts link to a known runbook and which alerts lack a resolvable runbook.

tools.name: obs_cardinality_estimate
tools.purpose: Estimate worst-case metric series count from per-label distinct value counts and flag a series budget breach.

tools.name: obs_probe_availability
tools.purpose: Compute synthetic probe availability and the longest consecutive failure run against an availability target.

tools.name: obs_mitigation_gate
tools.purpose: Decide whether a proposed automatic mitigation may run: whitelisted playbook, canary or staging (or full prod with A12), under the per-incident cap.

tools.name: obs_escalation_due
tools.purpose: Check whether an unstabilized sev 1 or 2 incident has reached the escalation clock (10 minutes by default) at a supplied time.

tools.name: maint_spec_pin
tools.purpose: Classify a dependency spec as pinned (one exact version), range (including wildcard components like == 1.2.* and compound specs like ==1.2.3,<2), or wildcard.

tools.name: maint_patch_priority
tools.purpose: Score a vulnerability patch priority from CVSS, KEV listing, exploit maturity, blast radius, and usage.

tools.name: maint_patch_deadline
tools.purpose: Compute a patch deadline: 24 hours for KEV or critical findings, otherwise the supplied SLA.

tools.name: maint_semver_bump
tools.purpose: Classify a version bump as major, minor, patch, prerelease, downgrade, or none, with its autonomy level. Implements strict 3-part semver 2.0.0 (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional -prerelease and +build; empty or leading-zero numeric prerelease identifiers are rejected).

tools.name: maint_eol_distance
tools.purpose: Measure days from a review date to platform EOL and flag upgrade epics and EOL compliance findings.

tools.name: maint_unpinned_count
tools.purpose: Count dependency version specifiers that are not exact pins, including wildcard and unconstrained entries; compound specs such as ==1.2.3,<2 count as ranges.

tools.name: maint_stale_age
tools.purpose: Compute how many days a dependency release trails the latest release and whether it breaches the staleness threshold.

tools.name: maint_debt_priority
tools.purpose: Score a tech-debt item from impact, recurrence, and effort, and propose its planning iteration.

tools.name: maint_license_change
tools.purpose: Detect SPDX license changes between two records and flag allowlist breaches and newly introduced copyleft terms.

tools.name: maint_changelog_check
tools.purpose: Validate one Keep a Changelog release entry: heading, version match, date, categories, and bullets.

tools.name: maint_hotfix_decision
tools.purpose: Apply the hotfix-versus-rollback rule: sev 1 or 2 (sev 1 is the worst) primes the hotfix path, a low-risk rollback is preferred, a hotfix needs a root-cause fix under 4 h.

tools.name: maint_version_affected
tools.purpose: Say whether a semver version lies inside an advisory range of comma-separated <, <=, >= and > clauses.

tools.name: docs_heading_order
tools.purpose: Count H1 headings and skipped heading levels in a markdown fragment.

tools.name: docs_link_targets
tools.purpose: Resolve repo-relative markdown link targets against a supplied file list and report broken internal links.

tools.name: docs_anchor_check
tools.purpose: Derive GitHub-style heading anchors from supplied headings and report fragment references that match none of them.

tools.name: docs_changelog_section_order
tools.purpose: Check one Keep-a-Changelog release block for unknown, duplicate and out-of-order section headings.

tools.name: docs_conventional_groups
tools.purpose: Group supplied conventional-commit subjects into Keep-a-Changelog sections and count breaking changes.

tools.name: docs_api_endpoint_coverage
tools.purpose: Compute the percentage of API endpoints present in the documented endpoint list, with undocumented and unmatched entries.

tools.name: docs_flesch_grade
tools.purpose: Score supplied prose with Flesch-Kincaid grade and reading ease and compare the grade against a limit.

tools.name: docs_stale_doc_age
tools.purpose: Compute document age in days from supplied verified dates and list documents older than the staleness limit.

tools.name: docs_runbook_verified_ratio
tools.purpose: Compute the share of tier-1 runbooks with a recent valid verified date against a target percentage.

tools.name: docs_adr_render_coverage
tools.purpose: Compute the share of in-scope ADRs rendered into docs and list missing and orphan renders.

tools.name: docs_runbook_schema_check
tools.purpose: Validate runbook fragments against A13's executable schema and list missing fields, unknown actions, bad dates and whitelisted actions that are not reversible steps.

tools.name: docs_digest_staleness
tools.purpose: Apply the staleness law: compare each document's bound artifact digest with the current digest and list stale and unbound documents and the stale artifact scopes.

tools.name: docs_terminology_drift
tools.purpose: Lint supplied markdown files against a glossary of preferred and deprecated terms, reporting each violation with file and line and the files that pass.

tools.name: cloud_twelve_factor_audit
tools.purpose: Score a service descriptor against the twelve factors: per-factor pass rate, overall score and findings. An omitted field counts as not passed and fails closed (major for a major-class check).

tools.name: cloud_composite_availability

tools.purpose: Check a t-of-n secret-share distribution: loss and compromise tolerance and quorum independence by custodian, organization and country.

tools.name: custody_signer_policy_lint
tools.purpose: Lint a signer policy: limits, allowlist enforcement, new-address cool-off, velocity, approval expiry and policy-change quorum.

tools.name: custody_wallet_tier_caps
tools.purpose: Check hot, warm and cold wallet balances against percentage and absolute caps and a minimum cold share; report what to sweep.

tools.name: custody_key_rotation
tools.purpose: Compare each key's age since creation or last rotation with its maximum age: overdue, due soon or ok.

tools.name: custody_tx_policy_eval
tools.purpose: Evaluate a transaction descriptor against custody policy and return allow, hold or deny with reasons; it never signs.

tools.name: custody_sanctions_screening
tools.purpose: Check sanctions screening records: list freshness at screening time, screening age and the action taken for each match state.

tools.name: custody_travel_rule
tools.purpose: Check FATF Recommendation 16 originator and beneficiary data completeness for a transfer above the regime's threshold (comparison selects at_or_above or above); below it a missing name or account is reported as info.

tools.name: custody_audit_trail
tools.purpose: Verify a custody audit trail: contiguous sequence, SHA-256 hash chain, ordered timestamps, who and what, independent approvals.

tools.name: custody_recovery_drill
tools.purpose: Check recovery drill recency, outcome and recovery time per required scenario: never, failed, over target, overdue or current.

tools.name: custody_secret_scan
tools.purpose: Scan supplied file contents for private-key material and report path, line, kind and length only, never the value.

tools.name: shared_verdict
tools.purpose: Derive pass or fail from finding severities using the same rule as the gate scripts.

tools.name: shared_toolchain
tools.purpose: Detect which language toolchains are present, as code_checks does for backend and frontend.

tools.name: shared_check_plan
tools.purpose: Name the lint, typecheck, and test commands code_checks would run for this repo.

tools.name: shared_git_head
tools.purpose: Return the git sha and branch that the build record hands to release.

tools.name: shared_handover_write
tools.purpose: Write the versioned handover for a task to the next agent: goal, done, remaining, constraints, artifacts with digests; validated, redacted, size-capped and digest-sealed, from_agent is always the caller.

tools.name: shared_handover_read
tools.purpose: Read the newest (or a given seq) handover of a task, re-validated and digest-checked, with its status ok, missing, partial, stale or malformed and the reasons.

tools.name: shared_handover_validate
tools.purpose: Validate a handover document against swarm.handover.v1 and the semantic rules before writing it; reports every problem by field, its stored size and whether it would be summarized.

tools.name: shared_handover_bundle
tools.purpose: Everything a receiver needs for one task in one bounded object: goal, acceptance criteria, handover, upstream results and needs, artifacts, signed verdict summaries (stale: true for verdicts issued before the last rework), redacted lease mirror and attempts.

tools.name: shared_handover_verify
tools.purpose: Judge whether a task can start from its handover: handover status plus the state of every upstream task.

tools.name: shared_handover_receipt
tools.purpose: Record, idempotently by task, receiver and digest, what the receiving agent ascertained from a handover and the questions it still has; only the addressed receiver may write it.

tools.name: shared_artifact_digest
tools.purpose: Compute the sha256 digest of a file inside the workspace so an artifact can be listed in a handover with a verifiable digest.

tools.name: shared_artifact_check
tools.purpose: Check each output of a task: local file exists, digest matches, producer is the task's agent; non-file uris are reported unchecked, never assumed fine.

tools.name: shared_dod_check
tools.purpose: Check each acceptance criterion against a supplied result by deterministic keyword and evidence matching: met only with supporting evidence, otherwise unknown.

tools.name: shared_open_findings
tools.purpose: List the unexpired findings of failing gate verdicts for a task with their gate and issuing agent, most severe first. After a rework the failing verdicts that caused it are included and flagged stale: true; a newer verdict of the same gate replaces them.

tools.name: shared_attempt_history
tools.purpose: Show a task's attempt count, rework loops against the cap, state transitions and the last error, so a retry starts from what already failed.

tools.name: shared_lease_state
tools.purpose: Show the lease mirror recorded on a task (state, holder, ttl, age, expired) with the lease id always redacted.

tools.name: shared_open_questions
tools.purpose: List unresolved questions for a task: the needs of upstream results still waiting and the open questions of its handover.

tools.name: shared_status_report
tools.purpose: Record the caller's progress, blocked or done status for its own task and emit swarm.run.activity for the live bar.

tools.name: shared_scratchpad_put
tools.purpose: Store a JSON object under a key in the per-correlation scratchpad (8 KiB value, 64 keys, owner-only overwrite unless shared, optional if_version compare-and-swap).

tools.name: shared_scratchpad_get
tools.purpose: Read one scratchpad key, or list every key with its owner, version, size and update time.

tools.name: shared_escalate
tools.purpose: Record escalation.request for the caller's own task and return a ready BLOCKED task.result patch plus the escalation owner.

tools.name: shared_cancel_check
tools.purpose: Report whether a cooperative cancel was requested for the task's correlation, the grace left, and the seconds to its running deadline.

tools.name: shared_log_emit
tools.purpose: Write one structured agent.log event (level, message, scalar fields) to the run log with correlation and task ids; secrets are redacted.

tools.name: shared_route_check
tools.purpose: Say whether ACP allows a message type from one agent to another, from the live agents.json routing matrix, and why not.

tools.name: shared_escalation_owner
tools.purpose: Name who becomes accountable when the swarm gives up on a task: A14 when a direct upstream task is A14's work order, else A01.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--agent-recovery
skills.description: Use when a run is stalled or an agent's lease is dead; confirm the lease and attempts, requeue its in-flight task to RETRY and redispatch with the checkpoint.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--budget-enforce
skills.description: Use when a task reaches 80% of its budget or a breach is reported; warn, hard-stop at 100%, requeue once with an annotated budget, escalate the second breach.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--conflict-arbitrate
skills.description: Use when a conflict.report pits two agents' claims against each other; weigh ownership and evidence, record the arbitration, escalate L3 or ambiguous cases.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--dispatch-ready
skills.description: Use when a scheduling round starts with PLANNED or RETRY tasks; start only ready tasks within each agent ceiling and the global cap, leasing before spawning.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--escalate-human
skills.description: Use when a gate failed a third time, a budget breached twice, a poison task repeats, or L3 or L4 action is needed; record the escalation with evidence.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--gate-approval
skills.description: Use when a task sits IN_REVIEW with gate verdicts; check each gate it requires passed or was waived, let reconcile approve, otherwise hold and name the gaps.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--lane-join-review
skills.description: Use when every blast-radius lane is finished and only the join and one review remain; verify lanes, run the join, dispatch the single rev task to A09.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--parallel-lanes
skills.description: Use when a brief has two or more path-disjoint scopes; draft blast radii, persist a parallel plan and preview which lanes start under the agent ceilings.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--plan-decompose
skills.description: Use when a project.brief or signed plan task arrives for one stream of work; pick the pattern, read the budget, check the DAG order and persist the plan.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--rework-loop
skills.description: Use when a gate fails or a task enters CHANGES_REQUESTED; decide rework or escalation from the loop count, send findings back, third failure escalates.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--static-plan-mode
skills.description: Use when the Task Store or bus is unavailable; continue from the last persisted plan, queue transitions in the scratchpad, replay them on recovery.

skills.name: a01-orchestrator--status-report
skills.description: Use when a run ends or an operator asks for status; reconcile the correlation, check gate coverage per task, emit the table and swarm.status JSON.

skills.name: a02-requirements--acceptance-criteria
skills.description: Use when a story has no acceptance criteria or its criteria are weak, unstructured or manual-only; write Given/When/Then and prove them machine-checkable.

skills.name: a02-requirements--backlog-prioritization
skills.description: Use when a drafted backlog needs an order; choose MoSCoW or WSJF by size and escalate equal-rank stakeholder ties with an option matrix.

skills.name: a02-requirements--brief-intake
skills.description: Use when a new project.brief or change.request arrives, before any story is drafted: redact PII, score ambiguity and list open questions.

skills.name: a02-requirements--change-control
skills.description: Use when requirements change after the spec is PLANNED; estimate impact, raise a requirements.change and require approval above 20% scope change.

skills.name: a02-requirements--clarification-round
skills.description: Use when ambiguity exceeds 0.4 or over 30% of criteria are manual-only; issue a clarification.request within the 2-round, 48 h limit.

skills.name: a02-requirements--compliance-tagging
skills.description: Use when a brief names regulated data or a regime (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC2); map it to non-negotiable NFRs and prove the spec text is redacted.

skills.name: a02-requirements--conflict-resolution
skills.description: Use when two requirements contradict; publish the conflict matrix, exclude blocked items with rationale and escalate when they block the critical path.

skills.name: a02-requirements--escape-retro
skills.description: Use when a test escape or incident.alert points at a missing or wrong requirement; find the root cause in the criteria and draft a requirements.change.

skills.name: a02-requirements--nfr-elicitation
skills.description: Use when a spec has no NFRs or misses a category (perf, security, a11y, i18n); propose measurable targets and reject unmeasurable ones.

skills.name: a02-requirements--provisional-spec
skills.description: Use when both rounds are used and one went 48 h unanswered; publish a PROVISIONAL spec with assumption log, per-item confidence and risk of medium or more.

skills.name: a02-requirements--publish-gate
skills.description: Use when the spec is about to be marked VALIDATED; run lint, GWT, traceability, NFR coverage and the DoD check, then publish or block with findings.

skills.name: a02-requirements--story-authoring
skills.description: Use when a cleaned brief is ready and user stories must be drafted, scored for INVEST and de-duplicated before criteria are written.

skills.name: a03-architect--adr-record
skills.description: Use when a new architecture decision must be recorded as a MADR ADR, deciding L2 or L3 and checking that the status and file naming are legal.

skills.name: a03-architect--blueprint
skills.description: Use when a design.blueprint task arrives with allocated NFRs and a C4 blueprint with fitness checks must be authored from scratch.

skills.name: a03-architect--breaking-change
skills.description: Use when a contract change is breaking or external-facing and needs a major bump, migration plan, consumer acks and a human-approval BLOCKED packet.

skills.name: a03-architect--capacity-model
skills.description: Use when A13 sends a capacity.forecast and per-component load budgets must be derived, checked against NFR limits and handed to A11 for provisioning.

skills.name: a03-architect--contract-publish
skills.description: Use when a design.contract task needs a non-breaking OpenAPI or AsyncAPI revision validated, versioned, digest-pinned and sent to its consumers.

skills.name: a03-architect--data-conflict-split
skills.description: Use when the A07 data model conflicts with a published or draft contract and the contract must be split into versioned increments.

skills.name: a03-architect--fitness-run
skills.description: Use when a design.fitness task or a CI violation on main requires re-auditing layering, cycles, coupling and NFR budgets with a bounded fix loop.

skills.name: a03-architect--nfr-allocation
skills.description: Use when a requirements.spec arrives or an NFR changes and every NFR must be bound to a measurable contract clause or component budget.

skills.name: a03-architect--review-standards
skills.description: Use when a blueprint is accepted and A09 needs coding standards, dependency-direction rules and a coupling budget derived from it.

skills.name: a03-architect--stale-design-review
skills.description: Use when test.escape.feedback, incident.alert or patch.task shows a design decision is stale and affected ADRs need review and superseding ADRs.

skills.name: a03-architect--tech-stack
skills.description: Use when a technology must be picked from the approved catalog, or a catalog miss needs an ADR, with supply-chain policy and L3 escalation.

skills.name: a03-architect--threat-model
skills.description: Use when a design has a component crossing a trust boundary and a STRIDE threat model must be produced and sent to A10 for co-sign.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--a11y-sheet
skills.description: Use when closing a spec set to write the a11y.requirements sheet from the lint, contrast, focus, target and motion results already recorded for the run.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--a11y-triage
skills.description: Use when a11y.violations arrive from A06 or QA and each must be classified as a spec defect or a code defect, re-measured, and routed.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--focus-visible
skills.description: Use when a flow, form or modal has interactive elements and its keyboard focus order and focus-indicator contrast must be specified and verified.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--lofi-fallback
skills.description: Use when Figma is unavailable or the brand guide is missing and the spec must be produced as lofi or PROVISIONAL instead of stalling or guessing.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--motion-review
skills.description: Use when a spec contains any animation or transition and each one needs a duration bound and a reduced-motion variant before the spec is closed.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--new-component
skills.description: Use when no existing design-system component fits a screen need and a new component spec needs states, focus and target checks plus L3 approval.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--palette-contrast
skills.description: Use when a new palette, brand colour change or theme needs every text and UI colour pair measured against WCAG 2.2 AA with severities.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--responsive-targets
skills.description: Use when a layout changes across breakpoints or serves touch input and every interactive target must meet the WCAG 2.2 minimum size at each breakpoint.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--screen-spec
skills.description: Use when authoring or revising a per-screen ux.spec that must cite acceptance criteria and pass the shape, state and AC-trace checks before handoff.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--token-lint
skills.description: Use when a design-tokens file is about to be published or changed and needs a structural lint: token shape, names, spacing grid, breakpoint order.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--token-release
skills.description: Use when token values change or tokens are removed and the semver bump, deprecation aliases and the L3 approval gate must be decided before release.

skills.name: a04-ux-designer--usability-redesign
skills.description: Use when usability.findings of severity major or higher from QA or observability force a redesign task: compare options, resolve conflict, revise the spec.

skills.name: a05-backend--contract-deviation-request
skills.description: Use when an A03 contract cannot be met or is ambiguous; prove the gap, ask A03 one question, send a change request, go provisional after 4 h.

skills.name: a05-backend--contract-gap-baseline
skills.description: Use when a task pins an A03 api.contract; list missing and undocumented routes before any code is written and record the bound contract versions.

skills.name: a05-backend--dependency-bump-l2
skills.description: Use when A10 or A14 asks to update a package already in the manifest; apply it only if be_dependency_class says L2, then prove license, range and tests.

skills.name: a05-backend--flaky-ci-quarantine
skills.description: Use when a CI or local check fails intermittently; rerun twice, quarantine only the one test that passes on retry, report it, never disable tests silently.

skills.name: a05-backend--hotfix-minimal-patch
skills.description: Use when A14 assigns a hotfix with a defect.report; reproduce with a failing test, fix the root cause with the smallest diff and prove no coverage drop.

skills.name: a05-backend--new-dependency-request
skills.description: Use when a task needs a package absent from the manifest; classify it L3, check range and license, file the dependency.request for A10, do not import.

skills.name: a05-backend--perf-budget-guard
skills.description: Use when A03 annotated a hot-path performance budget; benchmark before and after, fail any slowdown over budget and optimise before submitting.

skills.name: a05-backend--pre-review-self-gate
skills.description: Use when implementation is done and before A09 review; run every check, shape the code.patch JSON, digest it and hand over only if it is ready.

skills.name: a05-backend--review-rework-loop
skills.description: Use when A09 returns CHANGES_REQUESTED or a gate verdict fails your patch; count the loop, fix by finding, rerun checks, ask for arbitration at loop 2.

skills.name: a05-backend--route-surface-hygiene
skills.description: Use when routes were added or renamed and a PR is near; prove no collisions, valid path params, allowed methods and statuses, and auth on every new route.

skills.name: a05-backend--security-remediation
skills.description: Use when A10 returns security.findings on your code; fix by severity, re-prove auth and license items, and stop at L3 for auth or data-access boundary changes.

skills.name: a05-backend--test-first-criteria
skills.description: Use when implementing acceptance criteria; write a failing test per criterion first, prove every criterion is covered, keep changed-code coverage at 80%.

skills.name: a06-frontend--a11y-selfgate
skills.description: Use when UI code is ready for IN_REVIEW; run the per-rule a11y tools and fe_a11y_check so serious and critical findings are zero.

skills.name: a06-frontend--api-contract-bind
skills.description: Use when UI code adds or changes an API call; match every call to a path and method of the pinned contract, type the client from it, and report a mismatch.

skills.name: a06-frontend--bind-inputs
skills.description: Use when an A06 task starts and before any code is written; read the handover, detect the toolchain, bind spec, token and contract versions, list gaps.

skills.name: a06-frontend--client-security
skills.description: Use when code adds HTML injection, inline script, external assets or web storage; scan changed sources for XSS, CSP, SRI and PII-in-storage issues.

skills.name: a06-frontend--component-catalog
skills.description: Use when a component is finished; type its props, write one Storybook story per state and Playwright component tests, and hand the catalog to A08 with evidence.

skills.name: a06-frontend--design-deviation
skills.description: Use when the ux.spec is ambiguous or undefined for a state or token, or the UI needs a new pattern or dependency; ask A04 one question and stop at L3.

skills.name: a06-frontend--perf-budget
skills.description: Use when a build output and a Lighthouse run exist; gate bundle bytes and Core Web Vitals against budget, code-split once on a breach, else escalate.

skills.name: a06-frontend--rework-intake
skills.description: Use when review comments, a11y violations, security findings or a gate verdict return A06 work; route findings to A06 skills and stop at the loop cap.

skills.name: a06-frontend--state-parity
skills.description: Use when a screen or component is complete; prove its implemented states equal ux.spec states exactly and close every missing or extra state.

skills.name: a06-frontend--token-binding
skills.description: Use when styling code was written or changed; scan declarations for raw colour and spacing literals and replace each with a design-token reference.

skills.name: a06-frontend--visual-flake-triage
skills.description: Use when a visual or component test fails intermittently; rerun it twice, quarantine (never delete) a flake, and send a baseline change to A04 for re-approval.

skills.name: a07-data--additive-migration
skills.description: Use when a data.migration only adds structure (new table, nullable or defaulted column, concurrent index) and can ship at L2 without a destructive step.

skills.name: a07-data--contract-evolution
skills.description: Use when a new or changed data.contract (event or entity schema) is planned, to choose the compatibility mode and publish it with a pinned digest.

skills.name: a07-data--destructive-gate
skills.description: Use when a DDL scan still reports DROP, TRUNCATE or a type change that cannot be split away, so it is prepared and not executed pending human approval.

skills.name: a07-data--expand-contract-split
skills.description: Use when a requested change renames, retypes or drops a column in place and must be rewritten as ordered expand, backfill and contract migrations.

skills.name: a07-data--model-ordering
skills.description: Use when a new or changed data.model (ERD) needs table dependency order, FK indexes and migration sequencing, with an ADR for any denormalisation.

skills.name: a07-data--pii-classification
skills.description: Use when a new or changed column or contract field may hold personal data and needs a tag, masking rule and retention entry before the migration merges.

skills.name: a07-data--privacy-request-plan
skills.description: Use when a privacy.request (GDPR/CCPA deletion or portability) arrives, to locate subject data, order cascades and prepare a plan a human executes at L4.

skills.name: a07-data--query-budget-review
skills.description: Use when data.access.patterns arrive or a query p95 budget is breached, to design the index set and prove it with an EXPLAIN comparison.

skills.name: a07-data--registry-outage-defer
skills.description: Use when the schema registry is unreachable at publish time, to pin the contract by digest, retry with backoff and defer the publish instead of forcing it.

skills.name: a07-data--rollback-rehearsal
skills.description: Use when about to set shadow_tested true: run forward then rollback in the shadow DB, reconcile row counts and check the EXPLAIN regression budget.

skills.name: a07-data--schema-drift-reconcile
skills.description: Use when A13 raises schema.drift.alert because a production schema differs from the migrations, to freeze contracts and plan a reconcile.

skills.name: a07-data--staging-failure-recovery
skills.description: Use when a migration has failed in staging, to roll it back, prove the data matches the original, and write the incident note and post-mortem.

skills.name: a08-qa--criteria-preflight
skills.description: Use when an assignment arrives with acceptance criteria that have not been linted, before any test is written or a tier is chosen.

skills.name: a08-qa--criteria-to-suite
skills.description: Use when linted acceptance criteria are ready to automate and you must author traceable tests in the tests/ zone.

skills.name: a08-qa--defect-triage
skills.description: Use when a failing test needs a defect.report: reproduce it, dedupe against known reports, attach evidence and route it to the owning producer.

skills.name: a08-qa--escape-analysis
skills.description: Use when A13 deploy.telemetry or a production incident shows defects that escaped testing and detection and escape rates must be measured.

skills.name: a08-qa--flake-quarantine
skills.description: Use when run history shows tests that pass and fail intermittently and each needs a quarantine, watch or consistent-fail decision.

skills.name: a08-qa--gate-run
skills.description: Use when a quality gate task is assigned and the signed gate.verdict for its targets must be produced from one real gate run.

skills.name: a08-qa--mutation-depth
skills.description: Use when a critical module changed and the strength of its tests must be proven with a mutation score against the 70 percent bar.

skills.name: a08-qa--rework-reverify
skills.description: Use when a producer returns work after a failed quality gate and only the affected tiers must be re-run for a fresh verdict.

skills.name: a08-qa--risk-tier-plan
skills.description: Use when a test run is about to start and the tier selection for the task's risk class must be decided and recorded before anything executes.

skills.name: a08-qa--runtime-budget
skills.description: Use when suite durations approach the 45 minute P95 budget or gate latency rises, to choose an impact subset or request lane capacity.

skills.name: a08-qa--suite-lint
skills.description: Use when an existing test suite needs a static audit for orphan tests, unexplained skips, bad names and rerun-hidden failures, with no new code written.

skills.name: a08-qa--waiver-request
skills.description: Use when a producer asks to waive a failing quality gate: A08 never self-waives and must route the request to a human with an expiry.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--conflict-escalation
skills.description: Use when A08 or A10 reached a different verdict than yours, or a third gate failure or poison task occurs, and A01 must arbitrate.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--contract-conformance
skills.description: Use when the diff touches an API contract, a schema migration or acceptance-criteria references and its conformance to them must be checked.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--greptile-triage
skills.description: Use when the pull request has Greptile review threads to ingest read-only, map to gate targets and feed into the review as findings you have confirmed.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--maintainability
skills.description: Use when a large or long-lived area of code is touched and the review needs a maintainability lens: comment density, dead code, debug leftovers, naming.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--mechanical-pass
skills.description: Use when the diff passed the size gate and the rules-only checks (TODO, debug, dead code, secrets, bidi characters, missing tests) must be previewed.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--metrics-report
skills.description: Use when review.metrics is requested on demand or periodically and latency, false-approve rate and severity mix must be reported against the spec targets.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--rebuttal-handling
skills.description: Use when a producer disputes review comments (review.feedback) and each comment must be held or withdrawn and repeatedly disputed rules flagged.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--risk-routing
skills.description: Use when the changed paths are known and the review must choose auto-approve or full semantic review and decide whether an A10 co-sign is required.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--semantic-pass
skills.description: Use when mechanical results exist and the LLM is available to review the diff against the standards, producing rule-tagged findings with path:line evidence.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--size-intake
skills.description: Use when a new PR is assigned for review and its diff must be sized against the 400-line split budget before any code is read.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--test-adequacy
skills.description: Use when source files changed and the review must judge whether tests accompany them and whether the changed behaviour is actually exercised.

skills.name: a09-reviewer--verdict-assembly
skills.description: Use when all findings are final and the signed review verdict must be recorded with swarm_gate, risk-tiered, self-validated and handed to A01.

skills.name: a10-security--dep-request
skills.description: Use when A05, A06 or A14 files a dependency.request for one package before code exists and you must approve or reject it on age, license and KEV.

skills.name: a10-security--iac-review
skills.description: Use when A11 sends an iac.change or deployment.manifest and you must review infrastructure exposure, TLS, headers and privilege settings and score each finding.

skills.name: a10-security--incident-evidence
skills.description: Use when A13 sends an incident.alert and needs a forensic evidence bundle: relevant artifacts with digests and log lines checked for credentials before sharing.

skills.name: a10-security--migration-review
skills.description: Use when A07 sends a schema.migration and you must check its SQL for embedded credentials, over-broad grants and unclassified PII columns.

skills.name: a10-security--pr-gate
skills.description: Use when a code.patch arrives for the security gate and you must run the full scan, cross-check the verdict and issue one signed security gate result.

skills.name: a10-security--release-strict
skills.description: Use when a release candidate needs a security verdict no older than 24 h from a strict scan, with KEV re-checked and skipped DAST treated as fail-closed.

skills.name: a10-security--risk-exception
skills.description: Use when someone asks to suppress or accept a finding and you must check the allow-list entry, grade the risk, and route medium to A01 and high to a human.

skills.name: a10-security--sbom-attest
skills.description: Use when A11 delivers a build.artifact with an SBOM and you must attest it: diff against the last release, check pins and KEV, pin the digest.
