skills.name: a22-gitops--env-promotion-pr
skills.description: Use when a gitops.promotion task moves a build to the next stage; check values drift and gate preconditions, then open the PR without merging.

skills.name: a22-gitops--helm-to-kustomize-migration
skills.description: Use when a Helm workload moves to Kustomize base and overlays with no behaviour change; prove rendered-object equality and value parity per environment.

skills.name: a22-gitops--image-update-automation
skills.description: Use when a workload should follow new image versions through Git; pick a semver, alphabetical or numerical policy, require prod digests and attested images.

skills.name: a22-gitops--prune-safety-review
skills.description: Use when a sync, Git deletion or automated prune would delete live objects; list what goes, protect data-bearing kinds and stop at L4 for production.

skills.name: a22-gitops--rollback-by-revert
skills.description: Use when a failed promotion or canary must be undone through Git; build a revert PR, verify the reverted tree and gate, never roll back imperatively in prod.

skills.name: a22-gitops--secret-externalization
skills.description: Use when plaintext Secrets or credential-looking values sit in a GitOps repo; replace them with Sealed, External or SOPS references without printing values.

skills.name: a22-gitops--sync-wave-ordering
skills.description: Use when an Argo CD Application applies CRDs, namespaces, hooks and workloads together and sync stalls; order phases and waves so dependencies exist first.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--authz-default-deny
skills.description: Use when a mesh.policy task must add default-deny AuthorizationPolicies and replace wildcard or allow-all rules with least-privilege service-to-service allows.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--circuit-breaker-tuning
skills.description: Use when DestinationRules need outlier detection and connection-pool limits tuned so failing endpoints eject without cascading overload.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--dns-tuning
skills.description: Use when pods show slow or noisy DNS from ndots and search domains; count lookups per name, pick ndots or trailing dots, and judge a node-local cache.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--egress-lockdown
skills.description: Use when outbound traffic must move from ALLOW_ANY to REGISTRY_ONLY with ServiceEntries; match observed destinations and plan the L3 flip.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--gateway-api-migration
skills.description: Use when Ingress or VirtualService edge routes move to Gateway API and Gateways, HTTPRoutes, attachment and ReferenceGrants must be proven valid before cutover.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--ingress-tls-hardening
skills.description: Use when ingress or gateway listeners need a TLS review: version floor, cipher suites, certificate SANs, HSTS and plaintext listeners, with an ordered fix list.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--mesh-upgrade-canary
skills.description: Use when the service mesh control plane or data plane must be upgraded; plan a revision-based canary with policy before/after diff, headroom check and rollback.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--multi-cluster-connectivity
skills.description: Use when clusters must join one mesh or routed network; prove pod, service and node CIDRs do not collide and choose gateway or routed connectivity.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--netpol-default-deny-rollout
skills.description: Use when namespaces lack NetworkPolicy default-deny and a staged ingress-then-egress rollout with DNS and flow proofs and a netpol.coverage.report is needed.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--retry-timeout-budget
skills.description: Use when a service call chain needs retry and timeout settings that cannot amplify load or invert deadlines; compute the multiplier and timeout gaps per hop.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--strict-mtls-rollout
skills.description: Use when a mesh.policy task moves a namespace or the mesh from PERMISSIVE to STRICT mTLS and needs coverage proof, client checks and an L3 flip plan.

skills.name: a23-mesh-network--traffic-shifting-plan
skills.description: Use when a release needs a weighted canary or blue-green traffic.plan for a mesh service; validate weights, subsets and rollback before A12 promotes.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--admission-policy-authoring
skills.description: Use when a new ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, Kyverno or Gatekeeper rule must be written and proven fail-closed in audit mode before any enforcement.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--audit-logging-setup
skills.description: Use when a kube-apiserver audit policy must be written or verified so secrets, tokens, RBAC, exec and admission changes are logged at the right level.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--cis-benchmark-run
skills.description: Use when CIS Kubernetes Benchmark results (kube-bench output) must be scored against a pass-rate threshold with Level 1 failures and per-section gaps reported.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--cluster-incident-containment
skills.description: Use when a runtime alert or suspected workload compromise needs evidence kept, blast radius sized and a containment plan prepared for human approval.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--exception-lifecycle
skills.description: Use when a policy exception register must be audited for expiry, lifetime, review and approver hygiene, or a new exception is requested and must go to a human.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--image-admission-signing
skills.description: Use when workload images must be limited to allowed registries, pinned by digest and matched to verified signature digests before an admission rule enforces it.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--policy-as-code-testing
skills.description: Use when a policy set needs a regression suite of must-fail and must-pass manifests run through the scan script, the lint and the engine's own test runner.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--pss-enforce-rollout
skills.description: Use when namespaces must move to Pod Security Admission baseline or restricted and a staged warn/audit then enforce plan with workload evidence is needed.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--rbac-least-privilege-review
skills.description: Use when Roles, ClusterRoles and bindings must be reviewed for wildcards, escalation verbs and cluster-admin grants and tightened proposals are needed.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--runtime-detection-tuning
skills.description: Use when Falco rules are noisy, missing fields or disabled and alert counts must be turned into scoped exceptions without losing detections.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--sa-token-hardening
skills.description: Use when workloads mount service-account tokens they do not need, share the default account or use long-lived or legacy token Secrets.

skills.name: a24-cluster-security--tenant-isolation-audit
skills.description: Use when tenant namespaces in a shared cluster must be audited for PSA labels, quotas, default-deny NetworkPolicy and cross-tenant RBAC.

skills.name: a25-resilience--backup-restore-drill
skills.description: Use when a resilience.backup task must prove backups work: coverage versus RPO and retention, a restore-time estimate against the RTO, and a scratch drill.

skills.name: a25-resilience--chaos-experiment-design
skills.description: Use when one chaos experiment needs a hypothesis, blast-radius limit, abort conditions and staged promotion to production under an error-budget gate.

skills.name: a25-resilience--dr-failover-runbook
skills.description: Use when a resilience.dr task needs a disaster-recovery failover runbook with RTO and RPO budgets per step; production failover is an L4 human step.

skills.name: a25-resilience--failure-mode-analysis
skills.description: Use when a resilience.failure_mode task needs failure modes of a design ranked by FMEA risk priority number with evidence-backed scores and mitigation owners.

skills.name: a25-resilience--game-day-plan
skills.description: Use when a resilience.chaos task needs a game day: ordered scenarios, roles, abort path and cumulative error-budget cost, delivered as a chaos.plan.

skills.name: a25-resilience--graceful-shutdown
skills.description: Use when deploys, drains or scale-downs drop in-flight requests or hit SIGKILL; size terminationGracePeriodSeconds, preStop and drain time against measurements.

skills.name: a25-resilience--load-shedding-design
skills.description: Use when a service must degrade by priority under overload; size concurrency limits, reservations and bounded queues from Little's law and client timeouts.

skills.name: a25-resilience--pdb-and-spread-hardening
skills.description: Use when workload manifests lack PodDisruptionBudgets, zone spread or anti-affinity, or a drain stalls; fix budgets and spread against replica and zone counts.

skills.name: a25-resilience--post-drill-report
skills.description: Use when a drill, game day or chaos run has finished and needs a resilience.report: hypothesis result, measured RTO and RPO, defects and next due date.

skills.name: a25-resilience--probe-tuning
skills.description: Use when pods restart in loops, receive traffic before they are ready, or probes look wrong; tune startup, liveness and readiness against measured start time.

skills.name: a25-resilience--quorum-protection
skills.description: Use when a replicated StatefulSet such as etcd or ZooKeeper must keep quorum through drains and a zone loss; check members per zone and its PDB.

skills.name: a25-resilience--resilience-regression-gate
skills.description: Use when a manifest or release change must not weaken resilience; block on new blocker or major PDB, spread, probe or shutdown findings in changed manifests.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--abi-stability-gate
skills.description: Use when a code.patch changes a contract with a released contract.abi and breaking ABI, selector or event changes must be caught before handover.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--access-control-roles
skills.description: Use when a contract needs an owner or role model (Ownable2Step, AccessControl) with every state-changing function guarded, evented and tied to a signer policy.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--audit-finding-remediation
skills.description: Use when audit.findings, audit.report or a failing review/gate verdict lists contract defects to fix with a reproducing test and a minimal patch each.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--deploy-script-dry-run
skills.description: Use when a Foundry deploy script must be written and pre-flighted into a contract.deploy.plan by simulation only; mainnet broadcast stays a human L4 step.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--eip712-signature-design
skills.description: Use when a contract verifies off-chain signatures (permit, meta-transactions, orders) and the EIP-712 typehash, domain and replay protection must be checked.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--erc20-implementation
skills.description: Use when a code.patch task creates or changes a fungible token (ERC-20, optionally ERC-2612 permit) and the result must be standard-conformant and test-gated.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--explorer-verification
skills.description: Use when a deployed contract must be verifiable on an explorer or Sourcify and a reproducible-build manifest with constructor args and settings is needed.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--foundry-test-first
skills.description: Use when acceptance.criteria must become failing Foundry tests (unit, fuzz, invariant) before code exists, then pass a coverage and campaign gate.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--gas-optimization-pass
skills.description: Use when a gas.report is requested or a function exceeds its gas budget, and a measured optimization must keep behaviour and the ABI unchanged.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--natspec-and-interfaces
skills.description: Use when a contract's public surface needs a documented interface (IFoo with NatSpec, ERC-165 id) so docs, wallets and auditors read one contract.abi.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--pausable-circuit-breaker
skills.description: Use when a contract holding user funds needs an emergency stop (Pausable) with asymmetric roles, events, tests and a human-only runbook to trigger it.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--storage-layout-migration
skills.description: Use when an implementation behind a deployed proxy changes (new variables, new version) and old and new storage layouts must be proven compatible.

skills.name: a26-smart-contract--upgradeable-proxy-design
skills.description: Use when a new contract must be upgradeable and a proxy pattern (UUPS, Transparent, Beacon) has to be chosen, written and checked before any deployment.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--access-control-review
skills.description: Use when privileged roles, authorization checks or signature-based approvals (permit, meta-tx) must be reviewed for centralization risk and replay.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--audit-report-publish
skills.description: Use when an audit.report task must assemble the final report from findings and fix review and pass the completeness check before release or publication.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--audit-scoping
skills.description: Use when an audit.static task starts and the audited commit, in-scope contracts, trust model and review order must be fixed before any finding is written.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--bug-bounty-triage
skills.description: Use when an external bug-bounty or whitehat report arrives and needs scope, duplicate, reproduction and severity checks without paying or promising anything.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--economic-attack-modeling
skills.description: Use when an audit.economic task must test whether flash-loan price manipulation or an ERC-4626 first-depositor attack is profitable, with a scored severity.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--finding-writeup-poc
skills.description: Use when a confirmed vulnerability candidate needs a reproducible proof-of-concept test, a scored severity and a schema-valid entry in the findings file.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--fix-verification-reaudit
skills.description: Use when fixes for audit findings arrive as a code.patch or fix commits and each needs commit, regression-test and re-audit verification plus residual risk.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--fuzz-campaign-review
skills.description: Use when fuzz or invariant campaign results must be judged adequate or not (runs, depth, seeds, coverage, revert ratio) before claiming the code was fuzzed.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--gas-dos-review
skills.description: Use when a gas.report or loops over user-growable arrays or push payments could make a function exceed the gas limit or be blocked by one failing call.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--invariant-design
skills.description: Use when an audit.invariants task must turn contract state and functions into an invariant.suite whose coverage of mutable state and funds safety is measured.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--oracle-review
skills.description: Use when a contract reads a price from a spot AMM, TWAP, Chainlink feed or admin setter and manipulation cost versus profit and feed hygiene must be checked.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--reentrancy-review
skills.description: Use when external calls, token hooks or callbacks need a checks-effects-interactions review including cross-function and read-only reentrancy.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--static-analysis-triage
skills.description: Use when Slither or Aderyn output must become deduplicated, SWC-classified, contextually scored findings with false positives recorded.

skills.name: a27-contract-audit--upgradeability-review
skills.description: Use when a proxy or upgradeable contract (Transparent, UUPS, Beacon, Diamond) needs its initializer, storage layout, upgrade authority and timelock reviewed.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--event-decoding-schema
skills.description: Use when a chain.indexer task turns a contract.abi into event filters and a log decoding schema: topic0, indexed layout, column types, unknown-event handling.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--gas-fee-strategy
skills.description: Use when a chain task needs an EIP-1559 fee policy for a sender service: max fee and priority fee with caps, runway in full blocks, and the cap that binds.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--hardfork-preparation
skills.description: Use when a chain.node task prepares a fleet for a scheduled hard fork: fork-ready clients, testnet rehearsal, rollout waves, activation timing, rollback limits.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--indexer-backfill
skills.description: Use when a chain.indexer task must backfill historical logs from a deploy block to head: window size, workers, duration and a freshness acceptance check.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--l2-bridge-monitoring
skills.description: Use when a chain.l2 task monitors a lock-and-mint bridge or a rollup withdrawal timeline: message lag, collateral invariant, challenge window, pause advice.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--mev-protection-routing
skills.description: Use when a chain task must pick the submission route (public mempool, private relay, sequencer) and slippage cap for swap, liquidation or mint transactions.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--node-incident-response
skills.description: Use when an incident.alert reports a chain node, RPC provider or indexer behind or failing; classify the cause and set remediation with its approval level.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--node-sync-and-snapshot
skills.description: Use when a chain.node task sizes or rebuilds an Ethereum-style node, choosing sync mode, snapshot or checkpoint source, disk, memory and client mix.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--reorg-handling
skills.description: Use when an indexer or service needs a confirmation-depth and block-tag policy plus a rollback rule for reorgs, by finality model and value at risk.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--rpc-provider-failover
skills.description: Use when a chain.rpc task needs a provider order, hedge delay and failover triggers for several RPC providers on one chain, proven to survive the loss of one.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--rpc-rate-limit-tuning
skills.description: Use when a chain.rpc task must split provider rate limits between live reads, logs, backfill and writes and set retry, backoff, batching and caching rules.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--stuck-transaction-recovery
skills.description: Use when a sender account has pending transactions that do not confirm (nonce gap, underpriced, aged) and replacement fee bids are needed for a human to sign.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--testnet-mainnet-guard
skills.description: Use when a chain task names a target chain id and environment and needs the network guard decision and required autonomy level before planning or mainnet.

skills.name: a28-chain-infra--validator-failover-safety
skills.description: Use when a chain.node task reviews validator redundancy, standby hosts or a client migration and must prove no key can be slashed by a double signature.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--account-abstraction-flow
skills.description: Use when a dapp.account_abstraction task builds an ERC-4337 UserOperation flow (bundler, paymaster) and field coherence and prefund must be proven.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--approval-hygiene
skills.description: Use when a dapp.signing task requests ERC-20 allowances, permits or NFT approvals and amounts, spenders, nonces and the revoke path must be limited.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--chain-switching
skills.description: Use when a dapp.wallet task adds network switching or wallet_addEthereumChain and the chain parameters and the 4902 add-then-switch path must be verified.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--ens-integration
skills.description: Use when a dapp.wallet task resolves or shows ENS names and normalization, homograph characters and forward-verified reverse records must be checked.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--error-mapping
skills.description: Use when a dapp.wallet task maps provider and RPC failures (EIP-1193 4xxx, JSON-RPC -32xxx, Solidity reverts) to user messages, retries and recovery actions.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--mainnet-enable-gate
skills.description: Use when a dapp.wallet task asks to make a mainnet selectable in a client; assemble the evidence pack and stop at the L3 approval, never flip the switch alone.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--rpc-fallback-client
skills.description: Use when a dapp.wallet task builds the client RPC transport from an rpc.policy and it must be key-free, meet quorum and fit the UI time budget.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--signing-prompt-accessibility
skills.description: Use when a dapp.signing task builds the confirmation shown before a wallet prompt and it must be readable, phishing-resistant and WCAG 2.2 accessible.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--simulation-before-sign
skills.description: Use when a dapp.tx_lifecycle task adds the pre-sign gate (eth_call simulation, gas estimate, balance cover, decoded confirmation) before a wallet prompt.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--siwe-login
skills.description: Use when a dapp.signing task adds or reviews Sign-In with Ethereum (EIP-4361) so the message, domain binding, nonce and validity window are verified end to end.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--tx-lifecycle-ux
skills.description: Use when a dapp.tx_lifecycle task builds the transaction status flow (confirm, pending, replaced, dropped, reorged) and each state history must be validated.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--typed-data-signing
skills.description: Use when a dapp.signing task builds an EIP-712 signTypedData_v4 request and its domain, types, chain, contract binding, deadline and nonce must be checked.

skills.name: a29-dapp-wallet--wallet-connect-integration
skills.description: Use when a dapp.wallet task adds or changes wallet connection (EIP-6963, EIP-1193, WalletConnect v2) and needs a checked capability matrix and connect flow.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--audit-trail-verify
skills.description: Use when a custody.compliance task needs a custody action log proven intact: hash chain, sequence, approvals, with the first break located.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--key-ceremony-plan
skills.description: Use when a key.ceremony task needs a witnessed ceremony plan and evidence checklist for key generation, shard distribution or restore; plan only.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--key-compromise-playbook
skills.description: Use when a signer key is suspected compromised and a custody.recovery task needs a containment and replacement plan plus evidence for human responders.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--key-rotation-plan
skills.description: Use when a key.ceremony task needs a rotation schedule from key age versus maximum age, with a safe add-then-remove order that keeps the multisig within policy.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--mica-evidence-pack
skills.description: Use when a custody.compliance task needs one evidence pack mapping fresh tool results to MiCA, DORA and Travel Rule controls as evidenced, partial or gap.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--multisig-setup-plan
skills.description: Use when a custody.policy task needs the m-of-n signer set, diversity rules and value tiers for a multisig; designs and verifies, never deploys.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--policy-repo-check
skills.description: Use when a repository needs custody policy files validated and a key-material scan that reports locations and lengths only, with scan gaps named.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--recovery-drill
skills.description: Use when a custody.recovery task must judge recovery drill recency, outcome and RTO per scenario, test shard survival and plan the next drills.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--sanctions-screening-process
skills.description: Use when a custody.compliance task needs the sanctions screening process defined or its records audited for list freshness and the action per match state.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--signer-policy-authoring
skills.description: Use when a custody.policy task needs per-tx and daily limits, allowlist cool-off, velocity and approval-expiry rules for a signer, linted and probed.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--timelock-governance-ops
skills.description: Use when a custody.policy task must size a timelock delay against value at risk, response time, cancel path, admin role and expiry window.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--travel-rule-readiness
skills.description: Use when a custody.compliance task asks if transfers carry FATF R.16 originator and beneficiary data above the regime threshold; uses synthetic cases.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--tx-policy-evaluation
skills.description: Use when a custody.compliance task asks if one transaction descriptor may proceed under custody policy; returns allow, hold or deny and never signs.

skills.name: a30-custody-compliance--wallet-tiering
skills.description: Use when a custody.policy task must set hot, warm and cold wallet caps and a minimum cold share, check each tier's signers and list sweep amounts.

skills.name: swarm-cooperative-cancel
skills.description: Use when a run may be cancelled or hit its deadline; poll shared_cancel_check at step boundaries, stop cleanly, hand over what is done and report state.

skills.name: swarm-dod-evidence
skills.description: Use when you must prove acceptance criteria are met; attach evidence to each criterion, run the deterministic check and report unknown as unmet.

skills.name: swarm-escalation-takeover
skills.description: Use when a task was escalated to you after retries or rework failed; read what was tried, decide re-plan, human review or cancel, and record it.

skills.name: swarm-handover-emit
skills.description: Use when your work ends or pauses and another agent continues it; write a validated HandoverV1 with digests and cite its id in the task result.

skills.name: swarm-handover-intake
skills.description: Use when a task starts from upstream work or a handover; verify it first, stop with BLOCKED on any doubt, then read the bundle and record a receipt.

skills.name: swarm-lease-discipline
skills.description: Use when you edit files or artifacts a task owns; check the lease mirror before long writes, stop when it is lost, and never touch lease ids or force.

skills.name: swarm-open-questions
skills.description: Use when requirements, inputs or upstream answers are unclear; list open questions, resolve what the record answers, escalate the rest instead of guessing.

skills.name: swarm-provenance-trust
skills.description: Use when you rely on upstream results, verdicts, handovers or artifacts; rank them by signature and digest and treat unverified content as a claim.

skills.name: swarm-rework-intake
skills.description: Use when a gate sent your task back for rework; collect the open findings, fix them by id and show each fix as evidence before resubmitting.

skills.name: swarm-scratchpad-protocol
skills.description: Use when agents of one plan share small working notes; follow the key, size, ownership and compare-and-swap rules of the per-correlation scratchpad.

skills.name: swarm-self-verify
skills.description: Use when you are about to report a result; run the pre-completion checklist: criteria, artifacts, findings, contract, secrets, then pick an honest state.

skills.name: swarm-status-reporting
skills.description: Use when a task runs longer than a few steps; report truthful progress, blocked and done through shared_status_report so the live bar and A01 see real state.
